title: Fiscal settings
productionBoundary: Production is configuration only at this stage. This screen does not enable issuance.
lookupSuccess: Company data found and applied to the form.
lookupError: Company data could not be found for this CNPJ.
cteRetryHint: Sets how many times a failed issuance is retried and how long to wait before each new attempt.
mdfeHint: SEFAZ requires the cargo insurer and the freight bank details when the carrier issues the MDF-e. Leave blank if the company does not issue MDF-e.
saveError: Settings could not be saved. Review the data and try again.

certificateErrorMissingFields: Select the PFX file and enter the certificate password.
certificateErrorNetwork: Could not connect to the API. Confirm that the local backend is running at http://localhost:53001 and try again.
certificateErrorNotYetValid: This certificate is not valid yet.
certificateErrorProfileMissing: Save the company fiscal profile before uploading the certificate.
certificateErrorRequestFailed: The API did not accept the certificate request. Code: {{code}}.
certificateErrorServer: The API failed while processing the certificate. Code: {{code}}.
